FAQ.title: What is 2 Minute Football?
FAQ.content: 2 Minute Football is a fast-paced sports simulator where you step into the cleats of a star quarterback. With the clock ticking down, your mission is to lead your team down the field and score as many touchdowns as possible before the two-minute warning expires. The game features intuitive passing mechanics, various offensive plays, and defensive AI that challenges your decision-making on every snap.

FAQ.title: How to Play 2 Minute Football
FAQ.content:
Master the gridiron with these simple steps:
1. Drag your mouse or finger to move your quarterback and find an open lane.
2. Use the targeting line to aim your pass toward your wide receivers.
3. Release to throw the ball. Timing is key to avoid interceptions!
4. Once the receiver catches the ball, guide them past defenders into the end zone for a touchdown.

FAQ.title: Tips to get a high score in 2 Minute Football
FAQ.content:
• Lead Your Receivers: Don't throw to where the receiver is; throw to where they are going to be.
• Watch the Blitz: If the defenders are rushing, get rid of the ball quickly to avoid a sack.
• Use the Sidelines: Running out of bounds can help you dodge tackles and find better angles for the next play.
• Stay Calm Under Pressure: As the clock winds down, don't panic—focused passes are more effective than random 'Hail Mary' throws.
